english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring to any person.
Use this when you mean any person in a more explicit or formal-sounding way.
Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for any person, especially when the person is the focus rather than the choice pattern.
Use this for an indefinite person or people in contexts where English means “whomever” or “any person.”
